page.notes: Printed on the scan: three columns of index entries and the running head INDEX. Entries are given in column order, first column, then second, then third. Columns are not marked with separate headings. Doubtful readings, not marked inline because the scan is faint or worn: "syncerit as" (the printed word is near "syncerita[s]"), "Alaricus Romā captt" (probably "captt" for "capit"), "Alexandri r. Decretalis" (the abbreviation is unclear), "Aquam vnde Helias inficcitate haburit" (the word "haburit" is uncertain), "Artium Ethnicorum vsus pijs contenffus" and "Apoftoli an alicubi fuerint pifcopi" (letters are blurred). Several page numbers in the outer columns are also faint. The small mark at the lower left of the first column is not printed text and is left out. No page number is printed on this page.
